name: eien
description: A local Markdown notes app for writers.

scripts.build:extension: vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts --configLoader runner && vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts --configLoader runner --mode content
scripts.android: npm run build:mobile && node scripts/version.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build:mobile && node scripts/version.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.version: node scripts/version.mjs && git add android/app/build.gradle ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj
scripts.test:e2e: install-electron && npm run build && playwright test --grep-invert @alone && playwright test --grep @alone --workers=1
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build:mobile && playwright test --config playwright.mobile.config.ts
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.ts
scripts.test:android: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug -q && cd .. && playwright test --config playwright.android.config.ts
scripts.test:ios-files: mkdir -p out && swiftc -O ios/App/App/VaultFileOps.swift scripts/ios/vault-file-ops-test/main.swift -o out/vault-file-ops-test && out/vault-file-ops-test && swiftc -O ios/App/App/VaultFileOps.swift scripts/ios/vault-file-ops-adversarial/main.swift -o out/vault-file-ops-adversarial && out/vault-file-ops-adversarial && swiftc -O ios/App/App/VaultFileOps.swift scripts/ios/vault-file-coordination/main.swift -o out/vault-file-coordination && out/vault-file-coordination
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
